quote: Metso has signed a major agreement with Southern Peru Copper Corporation… for the supply of copper Solvent Extraction and Electrowinning (SX-EW) technology to the company’s Tia Maria project in Cocachacra, Province of Islay, Arequipa, Peru. The new plant will produce 120,000 tons of high-purity (LME grade A) copper cathodes per year. The order value of EUR 100 million has been booked in the Minerals segment’s 2026 first-quarter order intake.
note: Opened Metso corporate press release; EUR 100m / 120 ktpa named. ECB EXR D.USD.EUR 2026-03-30 = 1.1484.
